name: Murmurs of Doom

automation.text: You begin a whispered dirge that is magically accompanied by the howling of spirits and other grim portents. For the duration, an aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation. When you create the aura and at the start of each of your turns while it persists, you can choose one creature in it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 3d8 Necrotic damage.
